approvals.schema:
CREATE TABLE approvals (
                    record_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(record_id,version))

audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE audit (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, at TEXT NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL)

cc_approvals.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_approvals (record_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_id,version))

cc_audit.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_audit (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,event TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL)

cc_heads.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_heads (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,head INTEGER NOT NULL,withdrawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

cc_meta.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

cc_names.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_names (record_id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_id,name))

cc_releases.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_releases (release_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,base_release TEXT NOT NULL,request_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL)

cc_revisions.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_revisions (record_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_id,version))

cc_sources.schema: CREATE TABLE cc_sources (source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot TEXT NOT NULL)

meta.schema: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

ownership.schema:
CREATE TABLE ownership (
                    alias TEXT NOT NULL, record_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(alias,record_id))

records.schema:
CREATE TABLE records (
                    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, head INTEGER NOT NULL, withdrawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

releases.schema:
CREATE TABLE releases (
                    release_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    hash TEXT NOT NULL, request_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL)

revisions.schema:
CREATE TABLE revisions (
                    record_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(record_id,version))
